entries.reviewNotes: Read restaurant context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Small-portion choice, personal strong-flavor impression and no obligation to order more remain distinct from criticism of preparation; service/customer roles retained.

Read construction record-assistant context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Checked no completion-date promise, no disclosure of schedule, no entry permission, return to records and explicit handover. Hindi reception wording corrected to a reception desk rather than abstract welcome.

Read bank merchant-payment consultation context and all twelve turn/hint sets. Checked one-day outdoor use, unconfirmed power and communications, no home-operation guarantee, contract/billing-period questions and delayed advertising; no bank approval implied.

Read station service-counter context and all twelve turn/hint sets. Checked number twelve, preserving queue priority while sitting with luggage, visible call display and responding to number rather than following another customer. Corrected Hindi/Bengali thanks response to natural service register.

Read temple-room entry context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Laced boots, seated preparation out of queue, coordinating entry with companion and delaying next plan to allow shoes on departure are preserved. No real temple policy added.

Read shrine photography context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Checked five family members with brother photographing the other four in two rows, one shot, yielding space, brother photographed elsewhere and all bags collected. No substantive translation error found.

Read guided castle-site tour context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Headcount notification before toilet departure, wife continuing independently, clock at exit meeting, no other tour queue and take-home guide checked. Source hint at turn8 simplifies avoidance of other groups but dialogue is preserved.

Read hospital visiting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Father’s rest preference, letter only today, photos on later requested visit and no immediate long reply preserved. Vietnamese staff question corrected so the visitor is asked what to say to father, not greeted by the question.

Read police-visit consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Six children aged seven to nine, one current adult and possible second escort, two candidate dates and no vehicle-ride promise retained; no service availability or personal-data collection approval inferred.

Read sister souvenir-shopping context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Different color preferences, navy versus white comparison, matching small brooch design, two brooches only and no clothing purchase retained. Sister relationship and staff/customer roles remain coherent.

Read castle stone-wall guide context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Thirty-minute availability, gate-near short tour, viewing whole shape before corner joints and using remaining time from current position preserved; no construction instruction added.

Read self-service udon context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Only own used tray, dishes and chopsticks returned while friend eats; permission to wait, asking friend before water and final glasses/bag check preserved. Burmese return wording clarified to used dishes.

Read smoke-affected platform waiting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Same next local service, new waiting position with display visible, bag moved and staff checking smoke retained. Khmer easy-to-see phrase corrected to avoid contempt meaning; English boarding area clarified.

Read festival paper-flower handover context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Red entrance versus white stage, twenty/thirty counts, ten per bundle yielding two/three bundles, separate shallow boxes and no stacking preserved. No substantive issue found.

Read late-night convenience-store overnight essentials context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Toothbrush with case, small face towel, two-pair socks, 1300 yen plus five-yen bag equals1305 under1500 checked. Product counts and purchasing roles coherent.

Read izakaya slow-meal context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Two empty plates cleared, grilled-food plate/chopsticks retained, no transfer or new dish, water only and customer later telling staff to clear checked. Khmer reflexive changed from telling oneself to personally notifying staff; Burmese hint clarified staff removal.

Read ferry-terminal separate boarding context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Driver and pedestrian companion use separate reception, companion leaves station, own tickets retained and meeting at side waiting area of onboard information desk checked. Cabin/lounge wording remains general passenger space.

Read fish-box sorting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Distinct carrier/counter roles, count after placement not lifting, current four then five, matching carrier count and record-backed handover before additions preserved. No substantive translation issue found.

Read whole-fish portion/trimmings request context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Two similarly sized portions for two, soup trimmings separately wrapped, cooler bag and storage-label dependent use order preserved. Hindi customer request corrected from giving to asking seller to give packages.

Read curry-shop work-clothes protection context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Jacket on hook, apron fastened before sitting/service, loosened neck, front covering shirt, basket return and jacket retrieval checked. Burmese splash verb corrected; Japanese front/back tie detail retained without invention.

Read police-box previous-consultation contact update context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Last Thursday around14:00, staff-name note, old number unusable, new number and preferred noon/after18:00 contact times preserved; timing remains preference without promise.

Read hospital post-payment departure assistance context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Can stand/sit but long corridor difficult, hospital wheelchair/staff offer, main entrance shelter identified from diagram, family notified and seated waiting checked. No clinical judgment or new medical advice added.

Read library read-aloud relocation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Quiet users, children’s seats, controlled voice with pictures, skipped-page check and return-place question checked. Tagalog choose-with-child syntax corrected so it cannot mean choose a child.

Read tax-office limited consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Five questions with two answered and three deferred, October issue versus September covered month, monthly deposits and home details preserved. Simplified Chinese 看法 changed to reading method; no tax determination added.

Read tea-shop no-teapot context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Tea bag habit, strainer fit in small cup, noted strainer width, small leaf purchase only and return after measuring home cup preserved. Thai closing corrected so shop welcomes another visit rather than waiting to receive service.

Read tea-picking sample-selection context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Speed comparison caused two unsuitable leaves, hardness/darker color checked with staff, sample kept nearby and pointing before picking doubtful leaves preserved. No agricultural recommendation beyond fictional dialogue inferred.

changes.before: स्वागत है। काउंटर पर जाइए। नमस्कार।
changes.after: कोई बात नहीं। काउंटर पर जाइए। नमस्कार।
changes.reason: どういたしまして responds to the customer’s thanks; a literal arrival welcome is unnatural at this point in the exchange.

changes.after: ধন্যবাদ দেওয়ার কিছু নেই। কাউন্টারে এগিয়ে যান। বিদায়।
changes.reason: どういたしまして responds to the customer’s thanks; a literal arrival welcome is unnatural at this point in the exchange.

changes.before: Hôm nay chào bạn muốn nói gì?
changes.after: Trong lời chào hỏi hôm nay, bạn muốn nói gì với bố?
changes.reason: The original word order makes chào bạn read as greeting the visitor. NPC asks what the visitor wants to say to father during the brief greeting.

changes.after: I'll watch the display while waiting. When boarding information appears, I'll calmly head to that service's boarding area.
changes.reason: Source 乗り場 is the boarding location; passenger is already on a platform, so requiring another platform is unsupported.

changes.before: Pagkatapos basahin ay itatanong ko sa kawani kung saan ibabalik. Kung manghihiram kami ng kasunod, pipili kami ng bata matapos mabasa ang kasalukuyang isang aklat.
changes.after: Pagkatapos basahin ay itatanong ko sa kawani kung saan ibabalik. Pagkatapos naming basahin ang kasalukuyang aklat, magpapasya kami ng anak ko kung hihiramin namin ang kasunod.
changes.reason: Select/decide together with the child, not select a child; preserve shared choice after finishing current book.

changes.before: 我准备了五个问题，第一个已经解决了。接下来想确认工资文件的看法。
changes.after: 我准备了五个问题，第一个已经解决了。接下来想确认怎样看懂工资文件。
changes.reason: 書類の見方 refers to how to read/understand document fields, whereas 看法 naturally means an opinion.

changes.before: นี่ใบชาปริมาณน้อยกับคำแนะนำค่ะ รอรับบริการอีกนะคะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
changes.after: นี่ใบชาปริมาณน้อยกับคำแนะนำค่ะ ทางเรายินดีต้อนรับคุณกลับมาอีกนะคะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
changes.reason: またお待ちしております is the shop welcoming the customer’s return; รอรับบริการ makes the speaker wait to receive service and confuses roles.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
